pieces.name: Band – four-bar groove
pieces.description: Guitar strums, rolled keys chords with the pedal, and an eighth-note kit groove with an open hi-hat choked by the pedal. A whole session at once.

pieces.name: Band – slow ballad
pieces.description: A fingerpicked guitar with a dotted echo (it follows the tempo), soft keys pads with the pedal, and a light ride and side-stick pattern.

pieces.name: Guitar – strums down & up
pieces.description: Chord gestures: eighth-note strums down (low string first) and lighter up strums, then a slow rake down and up, and one big strum left ringing.

pieces.name: Guitar – bends, slides & vibrato
pieces.description: A lead line: a full-step bend and a pre-bend release, a slide in and a slide shift, wide and narrow vibrato, a half-step bend and a slide out.

pieces.name: Guitar – hammer-ons, pull-offs & palm mutes
pieces.description: Triplet hammer-on/pull-off runs, a hammered climb and a pulled descent (no new picks), then palm-muted chugs with an open accent and dead notes.

pieces.name: Guitar – fingerpicked arpeggio
pieces.description: A Travis-style pattern: the thumb alternates the bass on the beat, the fingers pick the treble strings between.

pieces.name: Guitar – sustain & let ring
pieces.description: A low open string and a high 12th-fret note left to ring, then a chord struck once and let ring through two bars: decay and the bridge’s sympathetic response.

pieces.name: Guitar – soft to hard
pieces.description: One note eight times from barely touched to hard, then a chord the same way: how the guitar’s tone and level follow velocity.

pieces.name: Guitar – recorded performance
pieces.description: The recorded reference passage as played, with its own timing, touch, vibrato and intonation: performance travels in the stream.

pieces.name: Ukulele – re-entrant strum
pieces.description: An island strum on a GCEA ukulele. String 4 is the high G, so a down strum starts high, dips to C and climbs: the strum follows the strings, not the pitch.

pieces.name: Keys – pedal & rolled chords
pieces.description: Short chords without the pedal, the same chords with it, a chord rolled up and one rolled down, then a melody over a held chord until the pedal lifts.

pieces.name: Kit – groove, fill & hi-hat chokes
pieces.description: Two bars of groove with ghost notes on the snare, an open hi-hat closed by the pedal, then a tom fill into a crash.

pieces.name: Guitar – tempo change: the echo follows
pieces.description: Short notes through a dotted echo: two bars at 80 bpm, then the music speeds up to 120 bpm and the echo’s repeats tighten with it. Tempo travels in the stream.
